name: UserMorph – Instant User Switching & Account Impersonation for WordPress
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
UserMorph by VerseSofts is the ultimate user-switching tool designed for Administrators and developers who need to work efficiently. Instantly “morph” into any user account on your site with a single click, completely eliminating the need to log out and back in with different credentials.

Traditional user switching is slow and requires navigating deep into the admin screens. UserMorph optimizes this workflow with a Smart Search Bar integrated directly into your WordPress Admin Bar. Simply hover, type a name or an email, and switch your session instantly.

Core Features

  • Instant Admin Bar Switcher: A searchable, AJAX-powered dropdown in the top toolbar for rapid account swapping from any page.
  • Search and Switch: Find users quickly by name, username, or email without leaving your current screen.
  • Seamless Switch Back: A dedicated, prominent button returns you to your original Administrator session instantly and securely.
  • Developer Friendly: The perfect utility for testing user roles, custom capabilities, and personalized dashboard views.
  • Advanced Debugging: Resolve customer support issues in real-time by seeing exactly what they see on the frontend.
  • Switch Off Mode: Logout temporarily to view your site as an anonymous visitor while keeping a secure link to jump back into your admin account.
  • Native Security: Built strictly using WordPress authentication protocols and nonces. Fully compatible with SSL and premium caching plugins.

Perfect For

  • Testing & Development: Quickly verify how new features or restrictions look for different user roles.
  • Customer Support: Reproduce and debug issues reported by customers by logging in as them securely.
  • Permission Verification: Test complex visibility rules created by plugins like Store Restriction.
  • Site Management: Efficiently manage multi-user environments without session conflicts.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the usermorph folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. You will immediately see the “UserMorph” menu in your Admin Bar.
sections.faq:
Who can use UserMorph?

By default, only users with the edit_users capability (Administrators and Super Admins) are authorized to switch accounts for security reasons.

Is my site secure while using UserMorph?

Absolutely. UserMorph respects all WordPress security protocols. It does not store passwords and uses secure, encrypted cookies to manage the switch-back session.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. It is ideal for testing WooCommerce customer accounts, checking order statuses from the customer’s perspective, or verifying “My Account” page customizations.

Can I switch back to my account easily?

Yes, a prominent “Switch Back” link appears in the admin bar as soon as you morph into another user account.

Where can I get support for this plugin?

We offer professional, dedicated support directly via email: contact@versesofts.com
